To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the free field can be characterized by the existence of no non-zero finite-rank operators that commute with the generators, that the strong Atiyah condition is equivalent to the existence of no finite-rank operators with a non-zero commutator with the generators, and that the free entropy dimension of a tuple of generators is equal to the free skew field dimension of the tuple if and only if the generators generate the free field.
the free field can be realized via unbounded operators, that this realization is unique and that it can be described in terms of the free entropy.
the free skew field can be characterized via a noncommutative distribution, the strong Atiyah conjecture and the free entropy dimension.
